objective: Test whether the scalar image on the realizable OOO dependency-residue quotient factors through a compact mechanically generated structural motif classification of OOO triples, using a frozen coarsest-first ladder before any scalar coefficient or holdout inspection.

frozenCoordinate.depth: exact frontier-relative depth retained by EW-RS-066

dependencyCarrier.source: EW-RS-065 deterministic matched degree<=2 left-kernel dependencies

motifLadder.name: WIDTH_CAPXOR
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: component width plus XOR checksum of the role-attached capacity-parity bits

motifLadder.name: WIDTH_CAPMASK
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: component width plus the exact canonical role-capacity-parity vector

motifLadder.name: WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_MASK_COUNTS
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: WIDTH_CAPMASK plus exact counts of residual masks in absolute owner channels r0 and r1

motifLadder.name: WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_MASK_SIZE_PROFILES
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: previous fields plus owner-separated sorted multisets of residual-mask cardinalities

motifLadder.name: WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_DEPTH_HISTOGRAMS
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: previous width/cap fields plus owner-separated exact histograms of residual-cell frontier-relative depths, while discarding role index and mask grouping

motifLadder.name: WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_MASK_DEPTH_PROFILES
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: previous width/cap fields plus owner-separated sorted multisets of per-mask sorted relative-depth multisets, while discarding role indices

motifLadder.name: FULL_DESCRIPTOR
motifLadder.descriptorSummary: the complete frozen ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC descriptor string; reconstruction control

tripleFunctional.motifKey: sorted multiset of the three descriptor summaries for each O_a O_b O_c structural triple
tripleFunctional.dependencyFeature: for each motif key, parity of the number of OOO residue triples in the matched dependency carrying that key
tripleFunctional.selectionOrder: motifLadder order above; select the coarsest family with zero scalar contradictions on every declared carrier

structuralMeasurements: rank of the motif-parity map on the frozen OOO dependency residues
kernel dimension relative to the OOO residue image
whether zero motif residue always implies zero scalar residue
scalarMeasurementsAfterStructuralFreeze: GF(2)^2 scalar contradiction count on the deterministic matched dependency basis
scalar image dimension after restricting to a structurally independent motif-residue basis
antiCircularity: The complete motif ladder and all descriptor-summary definitions are frozen before any scalar qualification result is inspected.
Motif keys are generated only from frozen descriptor strings and OOO triple identities; W/D/L labels do not influence any grouping.
The matched dependency basis and OOO residues are inherited unchanged from EW-RS-065.
The FULL_DESCRIPTOR rung is a reconstruction control, not evidence of compactness.
No individual motif key is selected, removed, split, or merged using scalar residues.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: FULL_DESCRIPTOR must reproduce the EW-RS-065 scalar factorization and target dimensions; failure invalidates the motif harness.
Any candidate with a structurally zero motif residue but nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
A candidate is selected only if it has zero scalar contradictions on all three declared carriers.
No post-hoc outcome-driven exception or descriptor split is allowed.
nextIfCommonCandidatePasses: Freeze the coarsest passing motif functional family and reduce its scalar image outcome-independently before fitting any closed syndrome coefficients; keep EW-RS-059 sealed.
nextIfOnlyFullDescriptorPasses: Record failure of the coarse motif ladder and move to mechanically generated DTS/exchange or minimal-circuit descriptors on the matched dependency carrier without outcome-selected motif refinement.
interpretationGuards: Passing one-hot motif parity does not by itself establish a closed arithmetic formula or universal law.
Motif-map rank and scalar factorization are invariant; individual deterministic basis rows remain gauge representatives.
No Q-A/Q-F, universal cubic sufficiency, standard-7x6 qualification, or center-opening proof follows.
